status: original implementation; component provenance verified; ICDI integration not yet qualified

retained_behavior: models interpret ambiguous language while deterministic code owns environment state
a separate audit precedes a terminal action
step capacity is reserved for a finish recovery
a sibling model is tried after bounded rate-limit backoff
two terminal steps are preserved for a first finish and recovery
a shopper task revision invalidates the previous terminal audit
serialized, columnar and identifier-keyed observations are restored before planning

original_icdi_architecture: ToolContract indexes only runtime-disclosed tools and JSON schemas.
MissionReader creates and revises a task brief from public request data and shopper replies.
EvidenceTrail preserves opening and step observations without product-specific lookup tables.
StepPolicy derives its behavior only from the disclosed maximum steps and current step.
ActionChooser emits one schema-checked tool call per turn.
TerminalAuditor is independent from action selection and does not reproduce a grader.
EnvironmentPort always sends the singular action envelope.
compliance_changes: Removed the released Board v4 structural foundation and rewrote ICDI from a blank file.
Removed elapsed-time strategy routing; time.sleep is used only for permitted 429 backoff.
Removed immediate rate-limit retry in favor of staggered backoff.
Kept the source free of suite identifiers, fixed product or attribute tables, grader code, direct network access and file operations.

methods.line: difflib SequenceMatcher over source lines with autojunk disabled
methods.ast: difflib SequenceMatcher over ast.walk node-type sequences with autojunk enabled

archive_corpus_scan.method: Maximum of line and AST-node SequenceMatcher ratios with autojunk enabled
archive_corpus_scan.note: This is a development diagnostic over the downloaded public archive, not ORO's private structural detector.

validation_boundary: These checks establish local syntax, contract, provenance and rule-oriented properties. Only ORO server-side analysis can decide submission acceptance, and only a fresh practice or qualifying run can measure the combined ICDI agent.
